format.description:
The format string with keywords in <>. Field names of CanonicalFieldInfo can be specified as keywords.
Specific value type of the keyword can be specified using a colon (:). The keywords are picked up automatically
from CanonicalFileNameInfo. There is special keyword 'customerFilePrefix' which can be defined on the canonical
and be used to determine the value of the field 'canonical'.
For e.g. C3_<customer>_Canonical_<canonical>_<timestamp:yyyyMMddHHmmssZ>_<locale>_<sequence>_<hash:md5>
timestamp
   supports Joda DateTimeFormat (http://joda-time.sourceforge.net/apidocs/org/joda/time/format/DateTimeFormat.html)
   default format is ISODateTimeFormat of yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZZ
hash
   supports md5, sha1, cksum
   default is md5
separator in this example is underscore

P.S. It is better to have a separator between keywords else file names might become unparseable.
Using special characters like '<', '-', '>' for separators will break the parsing. Having '/' in timestamp
will also break the parsing because '/' is used to distinguish file name from the file path.
Also, '<' and '>' are special characters, using them in the text or as separators will break the format parsing.
